title: Splitter
whenToUse: Can be used to separate areas horizontally or vertically. When you need to freely drag and adjust the size of each area. When you need to specify the maximum and minimum width and height of an area.

examples.name: Basic
examples.description: Initialize panel size, panel size limit.

examples.name: Control mode
examples.description: Control the size of the splitter. When one of the panels disables `resizable`, dragging will be disabled.

examples.name: Vertical
Collapsible
examples.description: Set `collapsible` to enable collapse. Can through `min` to limit dragging to expand when collapsed.

examples.name: Control collapsible icons
examples.description: Set `collapsible.showCollapsibleIcon` to control the display mode of collapsible icons.

examples.name: Multiple panels
Complex combination
examples.description: Complex combination panel, quick folding, prohibited from changing size

examples.name: Lazy
examples.description: Lazy mode, dragging does not update the size immediately, but updates when released.

examples.name: Customize
Custom semantic dom styling
examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of Splitter by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.

examples.name: Double-clicked reset
examples.description: Double-click the dragger to reset the Splitter.Panel to its default size.
